title: The subscribers who were charged twice
description: The Bank charges whatever it is asked to, but turns some charges down, and Payment Worker's whole batch comes back each time it does. Make sure each subscriber pays once.
instructions: Payments API takes the payments as they arrive and hands each one to the Payments queue. Payment Worker takes one batch of up to ten at a time and asks the Bank to charge every payment in it. The Bank charges every time it is asked.
The Bank is busy and turns some charges down, to be asked for again later. When it does, Payment Worker fails, and the whole batch goes back on the queue and is delivered again, from the beginning.
Three subscribers pay 2500 fifteen times each. Nothing on this canvas remembers what has already been charged, so you will need somewhere to keep that.

events.text: The overnight backlog arrives at fifteen payments a second
The overnight backlog is through and goes back to sending them one at a time

goals.title: Payment Traffic reaches Payments Balancer
goals.hint: The balancer is where the payments arrive. Sending them straight at one instance leaves the other two idle.

goals.title: Every payment is answered, and in under 100 ms on average
goals.hint: Answering means the payment is safely on the queue, not that it is paid. Work done before the answer is work the sender waits for.

goals.title: Each of the 45 payments is charged exactly once
goals.hint: The Bank counts every charge it is asked for, whatever your own code recorded. A batch that is delivered again asks for the payments it already charged, so something has to remember the ones the Bank said yes to.
